title: Joel Greenblatt - Investing Off the Beaten Path
summary:
Since founding Gotham
in 1985, Joel and his partner Robert Goldstein have developed the
firm into a large asset management company, well beyond the
traditional hedge fund model and offering mutual fund products for
the retail investor. Throughout his career, Joel has been a very
successful adjunct professor here at Columbia Business School and
has also published several successful books. Growing up, Joel intuitively learned about business from his
father, a shoe manufacturer.
